description: What one game sells for, from completed sales: the range and typical price of loose, incomplete, complete, sealed and graded copies, each region's and each edition's price, how fast it sells and its newest sales. Name the game by its page URL from search_games, optionally a region and an edition.

currency.description: Currency for prices, an ISO 4217 code: USD (the default), EUR, GBP, CAD, AUD, JPY, PLN and others.

edition.description: An edition slug from the answer's editions, e.g. "platinum". Needs region.

region.description: A region code from the answer's regions, e.g. "us" (NTSC), "eu" (PAL), "asia" (Japan and Asia).

sales.description: How many of the newest sales to include, 0 to 10 (10 when left out).

url.description: The game's page URL or path, e.g. "https://gamecollecting.app/games/playstation-2/gran-turismo-4". An edition's URL from this tool's answer works too.

name: get_game_prices
title: Game prices
